summary: The EXAONE API Platform changelog entry dated November 9, 2026 lists K-EXAONE 2.5 (750B), LG AI Research's proprietary foundation model, and states the service is currently provided free of charge. API keys are issued from the platform. The rate-limits page applies per-second, per-minute and per-day call windows, with a higher daily call limit for users who consent to their usage records being used for model training and service improvement; the API can be used without consenting. The platform terms grant a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable non-commercial use right and bar for-profit use of the model or its outputs; if the service becomes paid, fees will be posted on the site.
claim_steps: Open the EXAONE API Platform at docs.exaone.ai
Select 'API Key 발급하기' (Issue API key) and request a key
Optionally consent to usage-record use for training to get a higher daily call limit
